args.predicate: (function(){ var chunk=(window.proxy&&window.proxy.webpackChunkitemark)||window.webpackChunkitemark; if(!chunk||!document.querySelector('#ark-app-itemark-mount-container'))return false; var els=document.querySelectorAll('*'); for(var i=0;i<els.length;i++){var a=els[i].__vue_app__; if(a&&a.config&&a.config.globalProperties&&a.config.globalProperties.$pinia){ var m=a.config.globalProperties.$pinia._s.get('itemFormMain'); return !!(m&&m.initialized);}} return false;})()

args.script: (function(){ var chunk=(window.proxy&&window.proxy.webpackChunkitemark)||window.webpackChunkitemark; if(!chunk)throw new Error('boot: itemark webpack chunk missing - not on app-item/good/create (or the app is not mounted yet)'); var req=null;chunk.push([['__agx_'+Date.now()],{},function(r){req=r}]); if(!req||!req.m)throw new Error('boot: webpack require not obtainable'); var LV=null,Yw=null,ids=Object.keys(req.m); for(var i=0;i<ids.length&&!(LV&&Yw);i++){ var s;try{s=req.m[ids[i]].toString()}catch(e){continue} if(!LV&&/\bLV:\(\)=>/.test(s)){try{var e1=req(ids[i]);if(e1&&e1.LV&&typeof e1.LV.post==='function')LV=e1.LV}catch(x){}} if(!Yw&&s.indexOf('stage="upload"')>=0&&s.indexOf('directoryManageables')>=0){ try{var e2=req(ids[i]);Object.keys(e2).forEach(function(k){ if(!Yw&&typeof e2[k]==='function'&&e2[k].length===2&&String(e2[k]).indexOf('stage="upload"')>=0)Yw=e2[k]})}catch(x){}} } if(!LV)throw new Error('boot: shared HTTP client (LV) not found in the bundle'); var app=null,pinia=null,els=document.querySelectorAll('*'); for(var j=0;j<els.length;j++){var a=els[j].__vue_app__; if(a&&a.config&&a.config.globalProperties&&a.config.globalProperties.$pinia){app=a;pinia=a.config.globalProperties.$pinia;break}} var st=app&&app.config.globalProperties.$store; var ui=st&&st.getters&&st.getters.userInfo; var sellerId=ui&&ui.sellerId; if(!sellerId)throw new Error('boot: sellerId unavailable - the session is not a logged-in merchant'); window.__agx={req:req,LV:LV,Yw:Yw,pinia:pinia,app:app,sellerId:sellerId}; return {sellerId:sellerId,sellerName:ui.sellerName||ui.name||null,hasYw:typeof Yw==='function',hasPinia:!!pinia,modules:ids.length}; })()

steps.note: no module ids hard-coded: LV (signed HTTP client) and Yw (original upload job) are found by content

args.script: (async function(){var X=window.__agx,t0=Date.now();try{var r=await X.LV.post('/api/edith/product/publish_render',{data:'{}'},{transform:false});return JSON.stringify({pr_status:200,pr_code:r&&r.code,ms:Date.now()-t0,body:JSON.stringify(r).slice(0,200),via:'page-sdk'})}catch(e){var m=String((e&&(e.msg||e.message))||e);var code=e&&e.code;var signed=/请求详情|300015/.test(m)||code===-1;return JSON.stringify({pr_status:signed?200:((e&&e.status)||0),pr_code:code,err:m.slice(0,160),ms:Date.now()-t0,via:'page-sdk'})}})()
